description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [Awoken Spellblade], [Damage Cap +10000], [Buff Fire 30% (15s)], [Buff Lightning 30% (15s)], [Buff Ice 30% (15s)] and [Blitz Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Spellblade
description.text: Spellblade abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Spellblade abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Buff Fire 30% (15s)
description.text: Increases Fire damage dealt by 30%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Lightning 30% (15s)
description.text: Increases Lightning damage dealt by 30%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Ice 30% (15s)
description.text: Increases Ice damage dealt by 30%, cumulable

description.name: Blitz Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Blitz after using three Spellblade abilities
